an5.170:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ānando kosambiyaṃ viharati ghositārāme.
an5.170:1.2: athakho āyasmā bhaddaji yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā ānandena saddhiṃ sammodi
an5.170:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ bhaddajiṃ āyasmā ānando etadavoca
an5.170:1.4: kiṃ nu kho āvuso bhaddaji dassanānaṃ aggaṃ kiṃ savanānaṃ aggaṃ kiṃ sukhānaṃ aggaṃ kiṃ saññānaṃ aggaṃ kiṃ bhavānaṃ agganti.
an5.170:2.1: atthāvuso brahmā abhibhū anabhibhūto aññadatthudaso vasavattī yo taṃ brahmānaṃ passati idaṃ dassanānaṃ aggaṃ
an5.170:2.2: atthāvuso ābhassarā nāma devā sukhena abhisannā parisannā
an5.170:2.5: yo taṃ saddaṃ suṇāti idaṃ savanānaṃ aggaṃ
an5.170:2.7: te santaññeva tusitā sukhaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti idaṃ sukhānaṃ aggaṃ
an5.170:2.8: atthāvuso ākiñcaññāyatanupagā devā idaṃ saññānaṃ aggaṃ
an5.170:2.9: atthāvuso nevasaññānāsaññāyatanupagā devā idaṃ bhavānaṃ agganti
an5.170:2.10: sameti kho idaṃ āyasmato bhaddajissa yadidaṃ bahunā janenāti.
an5.170:3.3: tenahāvuso bhaddaji suṇāhi sādhukaṃ manasikarohi bhāsissāmīti.
an5.170:3.4: evamāvusoti kho āyasmā bhaddaji āyasmato ānandassa paccassosi.
an5.170:4.1: yathā passato kho āvuso anantarā āsavānaṃ khayo hoti idaṃ dassanānaṃ aggaṃ
an5.170:4.2: yathā suṇato anantarā āsavānaṃ khayo hoti idaṃ savanānaṃ aggaṃ
an5.170:4.3: yathā sukhitassa anantarā āsavānaṃ khayo hoti idaṃ sukhānaṃ aggaṃ
an5.170:4.4: yathāsaññissa anantarā āsavānaṃ khayo hoti idaṃ saññānaṃ aggaṃ
an5.170:4.5: yathābhūtassa anantarā āsavānaṃ khayo hoti idaṃ bhavānaṃ agganti.
